Tile # 1110690 THIS ZONING/LOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement") , 2011 by and between JOHN PHILLIPS, having an address at 52 Warren Street, Suite 5, New York, New York 10007 ("Lower Parcel Qwner"), and LADERA, LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Developer"), having WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Lower Parcel Owner is the owner infee of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon located in the Borough of Manhattan, County, City and State of New York,known as Tax Lot 26 in Block 1948 on the Tax Map of the City,County, and State of New York (the "Tax Map"), known and numbered as 307 West 121" Street, New York, New York (said land being called herein the "Lower Parcel Land", as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto’ and made a part hereof, said buildings and improvements,together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement being called herein the "Lower Parcel Building", and the Lower Parcel Land and the Lower Parcel Building being herein collectively called the "Lower Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer acquired from the Lower Parcel Owner the Subject Floor Area Development Rights (as hereafter defined), and a Light and Air Easement (as hereafter defined) located within the boundaries of the Lower Parcel Land (collectively, the “"Air Rights Parcel"), so that on the date hereof Lower Parcel Owner is the owner in fee of the Lower Premises and Developer is the owner of the Air Rights Parcel; WHEREAS,by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously herewith (the "Declaration"), Lower Parcel Owner and Developer have utilized the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (the "Zoning Resolution", as defined below in Section I. T) to combine the Lower Parcel Land and the Developer Premises (as hereafter defined) into one zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the terms of this Agreement (the "Combined Zoning Lot"), for the purpose of making available the Excess Floor Area Development Rights (as said term is defined below in Section I. I) for utilization in connection with the construction of the New Developer Building (as said term is defined in the Sixth Whereas below ); WHEREAS,the Lower Parcel Owner and the Developer have caused all of the other parties in interest (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Combined Zoning Lot, as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Stewart Land Title Insurance Company ("Certification"),annexed hereto as Exhibit C.to waive their right to execute the above referencedDeclaration or anyother Declarations relating toanyfutureexpansion of the Combined Zoning Lot and to subordinate their respective interest to this Agreement, as it may become amended,by execution of a Waiver of Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions and Subordination to Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement; WHEREAS, Developer intends (A) to acquire (i) certain land located in the Borough of Manhattan, County, City and State of New York, known as Tax Lot 35 in Block 1948 on the Tax Map of the City, County, and State of New York and known and numbered as 235 St.Nicholas Avenue,New York,New York (the "Developer Land"),with the buildings Lot 40 ZLDEA.v1 1131161.4

Certain Definitions.
